prompt: Build the state produced by: (1) the standard Simon's algorithm circuit for hidden 3-bit period s = 101 (input register qubits 0-2, output register qubits 3-5, oracle built as CNOT(control=qubit i, target=qubit 3+i) for i=0,1,2 then CNOT(control=qubit 0, target=qubit 3+i) for i=0,2 — i.e. bits 0 and 2 of s=101 are set — then Hadamard on qubits 0-2 twice, before and after the oracle), followed by (2) an additional RZ(pi/4) gate applied to qubit 0. Return the resulting 6-qubit state; no measurement.
